data.action: 漫步在积雪街道旁驻足，单手端热咖啡，微吐白雾，目光温柔看向镜头
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 冬日落雪的街角信使】白雪皑皑的龙门老街街头，雪花在路灯的光晕中静静飘落。德克萨斯裹着军绿色厚毛领派克大衣与米白围巾，单手拎着皮质邮差包，另一手端着冒着热气的纸杯咖啡。她驻足在街角复古红砖墙边，呼出一口淡淡的白气——「下雪了。送完这一单，一起去吃热拉面吧。」
data.lighting: 暖黄色复古路灯与漫天落雪的冷色微光
data.location: 冬日落雪的城市红砖老街转角
data.promptProse: At a red-brick corner in snowy Lungmen, Texas pauses with a leather messenger bag in one hand and a steaming coffee in the other. Keep the olive fur-lined parka and cream scarf in the slightly low medium view. The near wall turns behind her shoulder into the old street, where uneven tracks run through the snow toward the next block. Warm light from the existing streetlamp catches the falling flakes, her breath and the raised brick edges. Snow-reflected light softly fills the lower coat, and the bag leaves a subdued shadow against the wall-side snow without changing the cold evening mood.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 冬日落雪的街角信使
